tool_input.content:
import json
import pandas as pd
import hopsworks
from hsfs.feature import Feature
from hsfs.embedding import EmbeddingIndex, SimilarityFunctionType

NAME = "items5a26f7"
DIM = 16

# Load source CSVs into DataFrames (just to feed the platform ingest)
items = pd.read_csv("data/items.csv")
items["embedding"] = items["embedding"].apply(json.loads)
print("items loaded:", len(items), "dim:", len(items["embedding"].iloc[0]))

project = hopsworks.login()
fs = project.get_feature_store()

# Embedding index with L2 (Euclidean) distance
emb_index = EmbeddingIndex(index_name=f"{NAME}_index")
emb_index.add_embedding(
    name="embedding",
    dimension=DIM,
    similarity_function_type=SimilarityFunctionType.L2,
)

fg = fs.get_or_create_feature_group(
    name=NAME,
    version=1,
    description="Item vector embeddings for L2 ANN similarity search",
    primary_key=["item_id"],
    embedding_index=emb_index,
    features=[
        Feature("item_id", "string", description="Unique item id"),
        Feature("embedding", "array<float>", description="16-dim item embedding"),
        Feature("label", "string", description="Item category label"),
    ],
    online_enabled=True,
    stream=True,
    statistics_config=False,
)

fg.insert(items[["item_id", "embedding", "label"]], wait=True)
print("Inserted. fg.id =", fg.id)
print("STORE:", fs.name)

cd "$(pwd)" && python -c '
import json
import numpy as np
import pandas as pd
import hopsworks
from hsfs.feature import Feature
from hsfs.embedding import EmbeddingIndex, SimilarityFunctionType

NAME = "items5a26f7"
DIM = 16

items = pd.read_csv("data/items.csv")
items["embedding"] = items["embedding"].apply(lambda s: np.asarray(json.loads(s), dtype=np.float32))
print("items loaded:", len(items), "dim:", len(items["embedding"].iloc[0]), "dtype:", items["embedding"].iloc[0].dtype)

project = hopsworks.login()
fs = project.get_feature_store()

emb_index = EmbeddingIndex(index_name=NAME + "_index")
emb_index.add_embedding(name="embedding", dimension=DIM, similarity_function_type=SimilarityFunctionType.L2)

fg = fs.get_or_create_feature_group(
    name=NAME, version=1,
    description="Item vector embeddings for L2 ANN similarity search",
    primary_key=["item_id"],
    embedding_index=emb_index,
    features=[
        Feature("item_id", "string", description="Unique item id"),
        Feature("embedding", "array<float>", description="16-dim item embedding"),
        Feature("label", "string", description="Item category label"),
    ],
    online_enabled=True, stream=True, statistics_config=False,
)
fg.insert(items[["item_id","embedding","label"]], wait=True)
print("Inserted. fg.id =", fg.id)
print("STORE:", fs.name)
' 2>&1 | tail -40

import json, numpy as np, pandas as pd, hopsworks

print("type:", type(res), "len:", len(res))

print("first elem:", res[0])

cd "$(pwd)" && python -c '
import json, pandas as pd, hopsworks
project = hopsworks.login()
fs = project.get_feature_store()
fg = fs.get_feature_group("items5a26f7", version=1)
queries = pd.read_csv("data/queries.csv")
neighbors = {}
for _, row in queries.iterrows():
    qid = row["query_id"]
    vec = json.loads(row["embedding"])
    res = fg.find_neighbors(vec, k=5)
    ids = [r[1][0] for r in res]
    neighbors[qid] = ids
    assert len(ids) == 5, (qid, len(ids))
out = {"store": "items5a26f7", "neighbors": neighbors}
with open("submission/answers.json", "w") as f:
    json.dump(out, f, indent=2)
print("queries processed:", len(neighbors))
print("sample:", {k: neighbors[k] for k in list(neighbors)[:3]})
' 2>&1 | tail -20
